description: Inert training round standing in silo 571-7 with neither warhead nor propellant; the reentry vehicle mounted on it is a dummy with a hole cut in it to prove it inert; the silo doors are permanently blocked half open under a US-Soviet agreement; the museum has never published a round serial number so none is recorded
aliases: Titan II; SM-68B; LGM25; LGM25C; SM68B
